title: Artifact System Overhaul: Real Codecs, Runtime Reuse, Evolution
description:
Phase 2 of the stdio/domain artifact restructure. Phase 1 (ticket 26/08/10/STDIO-ARTIFACTS-AND-IO) migrated all 83 artifacts to the standards/subsets tree shape but left codec implementations almost entirely stubbed, cross-plugin reuse non-functional at runtime (typed registry never crosses the wasm boundary), no schema/standard evolution or migration mechanism, degenerate subsets (83 artifacts x 1 standard x 5698 identical any subsets), and enforcement that is pure substring matching.

This ticket implements the full plan at /Users/ueli/.claude/plans/the-current-import-export-snappy-thompson.md:
- D1: shared ArtifactDialect contract + io_dispatch seam + catalog SSOT relocation
- D2: real spec-conformant codecs for all 29 stdio artifacts (deflate LZ77, real PNG filters, full JPEG baseline, real GIF LZW + 89a, real SVG 1.1 semantic model + builder, gltf/glb merge into one artifact, real PDF 1.7 object/xref parser, full DWG AC1024 R2004+ decode, STEP/IFC Part-21 tokenizer, OOXML OPC layer), each proven via real-file analyzer->builder round-trip tests using 4 user-provided fixtures (thesis PDF, architectural DWG, animated GIF, glTF glb)
- D3: WIT ABI extension (list-artifact-dialects/artifact-compose/artifact-analyze) + host-side dialect router so plugins can call each other's builder/analyzer/composer at runtime for real (currently impossible - the registry only exists in-guest)
- D4: dialect-aware document evolution - ArtifactEnvelope gains an optional dialect field, a two-tier migration model (in-place for subset changes, new-lineage event for snapshot-type changes), hub multi-user dialect pinning, with a gif 87a->89a migration as the end-to-end pilot
- D5: PDF/A-2b as the first real (non-any) subset with a generic validate-on-build enforcement hook
- D6: nine structural policy rules in script.ts replacing today's substring/grep-based "enforcement"

9 waves (V0-V8), see plan for full breakdown, gates, and risks. Very large scope - this ticket will stay open across many sessions.
summary:
Phase 2 (Real-Format Grammars & Protocols) complete, verdict GO-WITH-CAVEATS, extending Phase 1's own already-closed artifact-schema-overhaul work on this same ticket.

Scope: all 32 official stdio standards now have handcrafted, real-format grammar (text syntax) and protocol (binary layout) files per the user's binding decisions (handcraft all ~192 files, real formats per matching dialect, no JSON/serde on transfer paths, binary-first with DSL fallback). DiffCodec/OpBinary upgraded from the old text-as-binary shortcut to genuine binary frames stdio-wide. Real fixtures, 5-role LanguageSpec registration, and schema-spec registration (where derivable) landed for every standard.

Execution: 3 serial mechanism waves (M1 grammar/lexer generalization, M2 protocol/walker generalization, M3 harness auto-discovery + registry API), a 6-artifact pilot ladder (json/csv/zip/png/txt/binary) + closer (grammar-recipe.md + policy seeding), 4 parallel fan-out waves covering the remaining 26 standards (FG1 text-native, FG2 binary-native, FG3 hybrid/heavy, FG4 OPC tail) each independently re-verified from disk (not self-reports), 2 small targeted fix waves (FG1's binary-frame shortfall on obj/stl/step/ifc4; FG2's jpg registration gap), a policy-finalize wave (PW, which also fixed a recurring m5 harness one-fixture-slot-per-artifact limitation, graduating gif/89a and pdf/1.7), and a final gate (G2) with its own independent re-verify agent.

Verified state at close: cargo test -p semio-s-plugin-stdio --lib — 1922 passed, 0 failures attributable to any of the 32 standards (1409 of their own tests, 100% green; the 1 intermittent failure elsewhere traces to an unrelated concurrent session's own in-progress artifact type, confirmed via a literal placeholder-fixture string). cargo test -p semio-framework-os-kernel — 796/2, exact match to the long-documented pre-existing non-stdio baseline (fem2d/en1992/dag), zero new regressions. Zero serde_json on any of the 32 standards' transfer paths. STATUS.md carries the full 32-standard ledger plus an orchestrator correction to one stale claim (trinity's check status, affected by unrelated concurrent churn discovered post-gate).

Remaining caveats (all non-blocking, documented, and outside this program's ownership boundary): cargo check --workspace is blocked by two unrelated in-progress concurrent refactors (a db-module import fix, a MediaWireFormat field rename) with zero overlap with stdio/dsl/trinity; docx/xlsx/pptx/bcf's Grammar facet and ifc/2x3 remain harness-ungraduated in STDIO_CONFORMANCE_GRADUATED for real, narrow, diagnosed reasons (container-vs-part-blind grammar harness check; one more fixture-slot instance left for a dedicated follow-up); csv/dxf/gltf's register_schema_spec absence is sound but under-documented in-file.

See ~/.claude/plans/the-current-schemas-are-scalable-journal.md for the full execution log (both Phase 1 and Phase 2), and this ticket folder's STATUS.md + p2-*-report.md files for per-wave detail.
